answer: The nectar schedule is applied in mirror and plume reveals each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2215 identities would post 571 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
